title: Kitchen
notes: This model is the kitchen, the dining booth, and the laundry as one cutaway. Advanced opens the hub room kitchen. Entity ids are the ones Kitchen All On (kitchen_all_on_2) calls. The older scene kitchen_all_on still uses light.s2_dimmer_2, light.s2_dimmer_3 and light.s2_dimmer_4; those are listed under not_in_model because the newer scene renamed them. Presets set these entities to match devices.json. They do not run the hub scenes, because the scenes are not the same set as the model. An empty entities list means the model can still show that device, and the hub is not called.

not_in_model.name: Kitchen Table Wall
not_in_model.note: In the main-floor scenes. The booth pendant is light.kitchen_table_overhead, not this wall light.

not_in_model.name: Kitchen Table
not_in_model.note: Older id in scene.kitchen_all_on. The current scene uses light.kitchen_table_overhead.

not_in_model.name: Surround Recessed
not_in_model.note: Older id in scene.kitchen_all_on. The current scene uses light.kitchen_surround_overhead.

not_in_model.name: Laundry Hall Recessed
not_in_model.note: In scene.kitchen_all_on and marked unavailable there. Not used.

not_in_model.name: Hood light level
not_in_model.note: The range hood light. It is a select (Off, Dim, High), and the hub has no action that sets a select, so the model does not call it.

not_in_model.name: Hood delay off
not_in_model.note: A hood timer switch, not the hood lamp.
